summary: Frontend-only validation of the new About page Leadership Team / Our Visionaries section. Page loads cleanly with zero JS/console errors. CEO card (KEN RUDNICK, Chief Executive Officer badge, 40+ Years badge) and all 5 director cards (PIRABA GURUMURTHI, INDAR MUDALIAR, NANCY KIRKPATRICK, RANDY DUIVESTEYN, VLADIMIR POSATSKIY) render correctly. All 7 images on the page load with naturalWidth > 0 (no broken images). After scrolling the page via mouse wheel, no content/img elements are left stuck at opacity:0 (framer-motion Reveal/Stagger animations all complete). Existing About content (Company Profile, Our Competencies, Our Facilities, Quality Policy Statement) is preserved. Header nav from /about navigates back to / successfully.
critical_code_review_comments: Image filename 'NANCY KIRKPATRICK.png' contains a space — works (URL-encoded to %20) but is fragile across deploy targets; prefer renaming to NANCY_KIRKPATRICK.png or nancy.png for consistency with the other director assets.

About.jsx is now ~286 lines and contains heavy inline JSX for the CEO card and director cards; consider extracting <CeoCard /> and <DirectorCard /> components to keep the page under ~150 lines and DRY the gradient/badge markup.
viewport once:true on Reveal/StaggerContainer is correctly set, which is what prevents the 'stuck at opacity:0' regressions — keep this as the project convention.

All 7 images (about.jpeg, ceo.png, PIRABA.png, INDAR.png, NANCY KIRKPATRICK.png, RANDY.png, VLADIMIR.png) load with naturalWidth=800-1600 px. rca of the issue: No issues found — all 7 acceptance criteria from the review_request passed.
